scenes.narration: Your whole research record on one screen.
Log every submission, each review round and the decision, with your own estimate of the odds.
Track grants from proposal to final report: requested and awarded amounts, and your share.
Your CV fills itself from those records.
Set a tenure date and your department's expectations; Vitae counts your record against each.
Free for Mac, notarized, and your data stays on your Mac.

bumper.note: Purplelink LLC brand bumper at start and end; narration never overlaps the bumpers.
